headline: Bone age
subhead: IS MEASURED FROM THE WRONG BONES

headline: Table of content
body: We are gonna go through 1. where bone age comes from 2. why the hand is the wrong bone 3. what actually predicts fusion in humans 4. what to do with the number

headline: F tier
subhead: READING YOUR LEGS OFF YOUR HAND (ABSOLUTE COPE)
body: Bone age is read from a hand and wrist X-ray then applied to your whole skeleton as if every plate is at the same stage. It is not. | Dolan et al (PLOS Biology): in mice *epiphyseal fusion* at **3 weeks** phalanges, **4 weeks** metacarpals, tibia and femur still open at **12 weeks**. Rats same order, **12** and **16** weeks vs still open.
punch: _The hand closes while the legs are barely started._

headline: Why the hand
body: Obviously the hand fuses earlier but more importantly it grows slower the entire time. At one week metacarpal growth rate was **49%** of tibial and *proliferation per column* was **46%**. | Every marker of *growth plate senescence* (plate running out of divisions) was more advanced in the hand bones at the same age.

headline: The mechanism
body: *Chondrocytes* from finger bones divide slower than leg bone chondrocytes. Add IGF-1 to the finger cells and proliferation rose **to match untreated leg cells**. | TL;DR the cells are the same, the hand just gets less growth signal. That is the whole difference.
punch: The bone is the same. The signal is not.

headline: S tier
body: MRI on **958 people** aged 14 to 21, wrist knee and ankle. Fusion varied by site inside the same person, complete fusion about **2 years earlier** in girls. | *Pubertal stage* correlated with fusion at every site, **0.514 to 0.598** in males. This is the variable to track.
punch: _One body, several closure dates, puberty tracks them all._

headline: D tier
body: Same study tested physical activity directly. No significant correlation in males at any site, one very low correlation at the female wrist (**0.095**), nothing else. | **BMI** did correlate, 0.186 to 0.384. So the thing everyone says spends your plates did not move them, body composition did.

headline: Final ranking
body: S: pubertal stage, tracked fusion at every site. B: BMI, correlated but weak. D: training, barely registered. F: reading your legs off your hand X-ray. | Use bone age as an estimate from your fastest ageing bones, not your legs.
